summary: Blue Acquisition Corp. (a Cayman blank-check company) filed an 8-K reporting a Fourth Amendment to its Business Combination Agreement with Blockfusion Digital Infrastructure, Inc. and Pubco, extending the Outside Date. No other terms were disclosed. This amendment keeps the deal alive, but the filing is routine and non-substantive; the actual special situation is the pending SPAC merger, not the amendment itself. Given the dearth of deal terms, the proper category is uncertain; conservatively, this is not a distinct special situation but a minor extension. Watch for shareholder vote and regulatory approvals.
